wpr.profile_inspection_observation: Serial wpr -profiledetails on the sealed f1_scale.wprp!PD5F1Scale exits 0 and reports PD5F1Scale.Verbose.File, WPR System Collector 128 KB x 64 with keywords CSwitch, DPC, IdleStates, Interrupt, Power, ReadyThread and Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Processor-Power 0x2ff: 0xff, plus WPR Event Collector 128 KB x 32. It warns that the profile does not support memory mode and selects file mode instead.
wpr.inspection_collision_note: One earlier concurrent read-only profile-details invocation returned duplicate control-library error 0xc5580601. A subsequent serial Power profile-details read succeeded. No WPR capture was started.
wpr.preflight_status_scope: wpr -status without -instancename checks the unnamed/default session only; it does not enumerate all possible named sessions.
wpr.ambiguous_start_cleanup: After any start attempt, finally issues stop only for the unique instance name attempted by this invocation. It never uses global cancel. Cleanup failure is recorded separately from the first failure.

review_corrections: Collector output moved to a dedicated empty native subdirectory.
SeSystemProfilePrivilege is required to be present; Enabled or Disabled is recorded, not gated.
WPR and collector helper processes use hidden windows.
Ambiguous WPR start cleanup targets only the unique attempted instance and preserves primary and cleanup failures separately.
Collector requires an owned-capture receipt and confirms the exact named WPR instance before native launch.
Capture intent/hash construction and write are fail-closed before any WPR start; failures produce a NOT RUN receipt.

Capture authorization is issued by the sealed controller as pd5.f1-controller-capture.v1; the wrapper-script hash check was replaced by a controller-source hash and claim-hash check, so no wrapper provenance is forged and the collector still refuses to run outside one supervised capture.

supervising_controller.job_containment: the collector runs as one member of the controller's named worker Job, which is the only Job the controller can terminate
supervising_controller.native_containment: the collector keeps its own pinned inner Job with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, so native F1 processes are reaped when the collector dies and are never members of the outer Job
supervising_controller.reclamation_evidence: outer Job active count zero plus per-pid ProcessRef liveness capture and death proof parsed from the collector's native logs
supervising_controller.stop_authority: the controller owns the exact instance name; the guardian performs the single raw stop and exact absence proof

runtime_asset_binding_scope: The finite read/update measurement resolves these two binary assets through compiled CUEXIS_SOURCE_DIR; warmup does not use sparseSource. All paths and hashes are additionally pinned in binding.json.
wrapper_repair: Cache process handles before polling and explicitly wait before reading exit codes.
Fail closed on unavailable exit codes; report progress and all failure outcomes to console.
Pin WPR and Python absolute paths and hashes across ordinary/elevated shells.
